ambient_events: Gear hangs in graded rows, every piece cleaned, checked, and accounted for.
A whetstone sits by a stool, still wet.
The quartermaster's ledger lies open, every entry in a small, exact hand.
description: The quartermaster's store: a narrow armoury-cum-shop where the Watch keep what they trust: no augments, no smart gear, nothing that phones home. Iron sights, hand tools, good boots, paper maps, honest steel, all of it maintained to a standard that borders on devotion. What you can draw from these shelves depends on what the Watch have decided you're worth. The common room is south.
name: Surplus of Sorrows
